The '''''Starcrusher''''' was a large [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Separatist [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kirst (admiral)|Kirst]].

==Description==
The vessel was armed with powerful [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons that could destroy several shielded [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] in a single salvo. The ship also had [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]].
It carried multiple [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] for emergency situations.

The ship's internal workings, including its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], could be reached by a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-sized vessel entering through one of its hangars. For internal security, the ship carried [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s.

==History==
The ship became infamous when it destroyed all [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] ships that attempted to attack it. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike force that included [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] was sent to destroy the vessel, but this turned out to be a trap specifically made to target the Jedi.

[[File:Starcrushers_end.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Both ships are destroyed by crashing into a star.]]
The Separatists created a [[Starcrusher (decoy)|decoy ''Starcrusher'']] to lure prominent Jedi Knights, anticipating they would infiltrate the ship to destroy it. The Republic sent several [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] to stage an attack on the CIS [[Tanker/Legends|fuel tanker]] [[Aurora (fuel tanker)/Legends|''Aurora'']]. The Republic fleet retreated as the huge Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warship]] arrived, leaving a [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] with a Jedi strike team to infiltrate the tanker and hijack an incoming shuttle sent from what they assumed to be the ''Starcrusher''.
The decoy vessel was successfully infiltrated, but sent on a crash course with a nearby star and the skeleton crew abandoned the Jedi to their fate.

The decoy ploy eventually turned against the ''Starcrusher'', as the ship entered the same system to pick up the skeleton crew. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the ship in his [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] and destroyed its reactor. The dead battleship was then pulled into the decoy vessel, which had become magnetized, and both fell into the gravity well of the star, destroying them and killing the ''Starcrusher''{{'s}} crew.
